key_insight: PlotGround creates a benchmark from real scientific figures paired with source data to measure how well models can recover plotted values in practical settings. It reveals that plot digitization accuracy on real-world scientific charts is not well captured by existing synthetic benchmarks.
problem_solved: The paper addresses the lack of realistic benchmarks for plot digitization. Existing datasets often use synthetic charts or limited chart types, making it hard to evaluate whether AI systems can accurately extract data from actual scientific figures.
method: Build an automated pipeline to construct plot digitization benchmarks from real scientific figures and their corresponding source data.
Ground evaluation in real-world chart images, enabling direct comparison between model outputs and known plotted values.
Cover a broader and more practical range of scientific figure styles than synthetic-only benchmarks.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, PlotGround provides a more trustworthy way to evaluate plot digitization systems in realistic conditions. This can improve model selection, benchmarking, and downstream use cases like literature review, data reuse, and scientific verification.
visual_elements: Side-by-side comparison of a scientific figure image and its source data table
Pipeline diagram showing figure collection → alignment with source data → benchmark construction
Accuracy bar chart comparing model performance on synthetic vs real figures
Icons representing scientific papers, plots, and extracted numeric values
paper_title: PlotGround: Grounding Plot Digitization in Real Scientific Figures and Their Source Data
paper_authors: Yaohui Zhang, Binxu Li, Haoyi Duan, Jiacheng Miao, Yixin Wang
